gaps.info: Passive DIP joint range of motion (e.g., whether passive flexion is full, painful, or restricted)
gaps.discriminates: Distinguishes true FDP mechanical failure (full passive ROM) from articular stiffness, PIP/DIP joint injury, or reflex sympathetic dystrophy

gaps.info: MRC manual muscle testing grade for DIP flexion against resistance (e.g., MRC 0–5)
gaps.discriminates: Differentiates complete functional loss (MRC 0) from high-grade partial tear (e.g., MRC 2–3) and guides urgency of surgical referral

gaps.info: Timing of DIP flexion loss onset — e.g., immediate vs. delayed (within 24h) after trauma
gaps.discriminates: Immediate loss strongly favors structural FDP injury; delayed onset suggests evolving hematoma, swelling-mediated inhibition, or neuropraxia
